name: The Lexington Times
summary: Independent civic-news project covering Lexington, Kentucky (Fayette County). Machine-readable local news plus a searchable archive of LFUCG government meetings. All public surfaces are CORS-open with no auth or signup.

content_provenance.sources: Public primary sources only: government press releases, LFUCG Granicus meeting video, court filings, and named news feeds.

ai_disclosure.news_articles: Drafted by Claude (Anthropic) from cited public sources; explicitly labeled AI-generated.
ai_disclosure.meeting_transcripts: OpenAI Whisper transcription; GPT-4o structured fact extraction; Claude Sonnet narrative summaries.

verification.news: Follow source.url and the citations[] array in /article/{slug}.json, or the Sources list in /article/{slug}.md.
verification.meetings: Each citation carries a clip_id and timestamp; open https://meetings.lexingtonky.news/meeting/{clip_id} to watch the official Granicus video at that moment. Official minutes are linked there too.
verification.guidance: We are a secondary source. For legal or official use, cite the underlying primary source we link, not us.

license: Built from public primary sources. Attribution to The Lexington Times is appreciated; verify against the linked originals for high-stakes use.
